draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kodaikanal! The British set this hill town up in 1845 as an escape from the summer heat and diseases of the plains, and at over 2,000 m up in the Palani Hills it's still way cooler than the rest of Tamil Nadu. People call it the Princess of Hill stations.
draft.hungryLine: Kodai eats well for a small town, from homemade chocolate and hot chocolate to café pastas, Tibetan momos and Gujarati thalis.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Kodaikanal Lake is a 10 min walk, the International School is 6 minutes away, and the Shembaganur Museum of Natural History is about 16 minutes on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Hire a cycle at Kodai Lake and ride around it while the clouds slowly come down onto the water.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kodaikanal International School was the first school in India to offer the International Baccalaureate, back in 1975.

spots.name: Kodaikanal Lake
spots.detail: 10 min walk · Star-shaped lake with rowing and pedal boats

spots.name: Kodaikanal International School
spots.detail: 6 min walk · Historic hill school on 43 acres

spots.name: Shembaganur Museum of Natural History
spots.detail: 16 min walk · Natural history collection going back to 1895

tips.title: Boat the lake on a winter evening.
tips.body: In winter, fog settles on Kodai Lake in the evenings and rowing through it is magical, just head back by 7PM as parts of the path get very dark.

tips.title: Carry your own water bottle.
tips.body: Small bottles of water are hard to find here, so fill up at your stay or the town's water ATMs.

story.title: Escape from the plains
story.body: Kodaikanal was set up in 1845 as a refuge from the summer heat and tropical diseases down in the plains. The British and early American missionaries shaped the town.

story.title: A lake is made
story.body: Sir Vere Henry Levinge, Collector of Madurai, created the lake in 1863 right in the middle of town. It's now Kodai's best-known landmark.

story.title: A museum in the hills
story.body: The Shembaganur Museum of Natural History opened in 1895, collecting anthropology, botany, zoology and handicrafts from the region.

story.title: A first for India
story.body: Kodaikanal International School became the first school in India to offer the International Baccalaureate Diploma in 1975.

story.title: Princess of Hill stations
story.body: Tourism keeps the town going, with boat pageants and flower shows on the lake every summer. Bryant Park sits right next to the water.
